channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Prenatal pesticide exposure not linked to autism traits
item.description: A study found no association between prenatal organophosphate pesticide exposure and autism-related traits in childhood, according to findings published online.

item.title: Antioxidants and Cervical Cancer Risk: What's the Link?
item.description: The idea that antioxidants may reduce cervical cancer risk has merit, but study limitations prevent definitive conclusions, according to a Medscape report.

item.title: CTE found in at least 1 in 4 former NFL players who died 2016-2021
item.description: A study by Mass General Brigham, Boston University, and the Concussion & CTE Foundation found evidence of CTE in at least one in four former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021.

item.title: Aspherical Lenslets Slow Myopia Progression in Children
item.description: A new spectacle lens with aspherical lenslets reduced myopia progression in children by over 70% compared with standard single-vision lenses.
